capabilities: Export the current note, a folder, or the entire vault to Markdown
Run the locally installed obsidian-export CLI with configurable options
Preview the exact command and live logs, and cancel an export
Confirm before overwriting files in a non-empty destination
Switch the interface between English and Simplified Chinese
extras: Desktop-only plugin (isDesktopOnly: true) that runs the CLI locally with no network requests; warns if the destination is inside the vault because Obsidian will index the exported files.
motivation: The author wanted to share notes that use reference-style syntax as Markdown rather than PDF, and found obsidian-export but wanted to run it without remembering CLI commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a note as a single plain Markdown file, and using obsidian-export means remembering and typing CLI commands in a terminal.

relations.evidence: this plugin makes it possible to run it from Obsidian without remembering CLI commands

summary: Wrapper that runs the locally installed obsidian-export CLI from Obsidian to export a note, folder, or whole vault as plain Markdown.
